revision: Compound Life / typography closer to original template / concise labels
common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined, realistic high-fidelity desktop UI for Compound Life. One continuous web app screen, target 1440x1024 landscape. Current date 2026-11-26 Thursday Beijing. This is a new revised concept set responding to three explicit user corrections: BRAND MUST BE "Compound Life"; typography must feel as polished as the original attached Kokonut template; all labels and descriptions must be concise and clean.

Reference image is the ACTUAL supplied Kokonut template screenshot. Study and closely match its elegant typography, restrained small headings, subtle light gray dividers, regular black/gray font rhythm, sparse iconography, compact list rows. Refine its layout for wealth management, removing duplicate nested cards. Do NOT imitate prior bulky designs. This should look like a beautifully typeset shipped web application, not a poster or an AI-generated finance presentation.

TYPE IS THE TOP PRIORITY. Brand exactly "Compound Life" in 18px medium-weight modern sans serif, normal title case. English and figures like Inter or SF Pro; Chinese like PingFang SC. Match the reference's sober Swiss-style UI precision and antialiased clarity. Page heading 22px weight500, section headings 15px weight500, body14px regular, helper13px regular. Figures 30px medium weight500 for primary net worth and 26px weight500 for secondary, NOT huge black heavy numerals. No bold overuse, no black grotesque chunky Chinese font, no calligraphy, no serif, no hand-drawn effects. Use tabular numerals, generous but measured line height, exact alignment. Any statement can be shorter by removing redundant descriptors. Use ALL key text precisely, no slogans or repetitive explanatory paragraphs.

Brand only "Compound Life". Do not display any other Chinese product brand name or the concept direction name as a page title. Sidebar 224px white, brand top, exactly six line-icon entries 总览 (selected black subtle round rectangle), 资产, 投资, 记录, 复盘, 目标; bottom 数据状态 and 设置, small household selector 示例家庭. Header 64px, breadcrumb 总览, search 搜索 with ⌘ K, moon icon, 示例家庭 menu. Main heading simply 总览, discreet date 2026.11.26 and small 演示 badge. One black primary action + 记一笔. No needless subtitle.

Palette pure neutral Kokonut: #FAFAFA canvas, white surfaces, #18181B text, #52525B secondary, #E4E4E7 thin rules, black controls. No glass, gradients, blue saturated highlights, yellow decorations, dashed borders, colored offset shadow, hand-drawn effects, ornaments, illustrations, marketing cards, oversized hero. Shadows only tiny or none. Container radius8px, controls6px. Separate groups through space and rules first. No floating card per row and no cards inside cards. No more than two main supporting areas.

DATA IS FICTIONAL. Top three summary labels 净资产 ¥4,280,000.00, 可投资资产 ¥1,860,000.00, 负债 ¥720,000.00. Only helper needed under 可投资资产: 含在途 ¥8,000.00. Under net worth a tiny explanation icon is enough, no sentence. A single nearby small amber status line 估值覆盖 98.6% · 1项待更新. Do not say all settled, fully current or all clear.
Monthly section title 本月表现, scope 可投资组合 in subtle small text, period controls 周 月 季 (月 selected), range 11.01—11.26. Three short metrics 收益 +¥10,000.00 (muted red #B42336), 净投入 +¥50,000.00 neutral, TWR +0.55% muted red. Thin bridge row 期初 1,800,000 + 投入 50,000 + 收益 10,000 = 期末 1,860,000, with a small ¥ indicator. Never imply household wealth growth is investment return.
Tasks title 待核对, exact simple row labels 基金份额, 定投记录, 账户对账, count badges 2笔, 3项, 1个, thin separators and chevron action. No long instructions, no repeated count in title and badge. Task counts are outstanding checks, not unexecuted transactions.
If chart present: title 财富轨迹, subtle legend 净资产, range 近6个月, y axis unit 万元 with small clear numeric ticks 380 400 420 440, x axis 6月 7月 8月 9月 10月 11月, thin charcoal 1.5px line with plausible fine fluctuations ending428, no area gradient, not a smooth illustration. Do not add a growth-rate badge to net worth.
Avoid English product slogans or decorative chapter labels; only brand Compound Life, TWR, keyboard key and established codes need English. Respect precise whitespace and calm compact original-template font proportions. All visible amounts and text must be crisp and fully legible, no ellipsis on financial values. No perspective, browser chrome, device frame, outside annotations, composite moodboard or multiple screens.

directions.name: 清晰账面
directions.text: Direction 清晰账面 (internal name only; never display this as UI text). Same overview-first hierarchy as a neutral wealth workspace: compact title row, 3 flat summary areas in a horizontal strip, single evidence line. Full-width shallow 本月表现 area with metrics and one thin bridge row. Below, 财富轨迹 on left ~65% width and 待核对 on right ~35%. Chart and task area have one simple outline each or just separate rules. Use maximum 5 clear region headings in total. The monthly area starts near y300 and lower chart/tasks near y520. Keep content fully visible within height1024, balanced whitespace. No holdings table. Preserve restrained font weights from the actual template.

directions.name: 趋势与行动
directions.text: Direction 趋势与行动 (internal name only; never display as UI text). Distinct trend-first hierarchy: title then ultra-compact horizontal net worth / investable / debt summary. Main content split approximately 70% left and30% right. Dominant 财富轨迹 chart on the left, ~330px tall detailed line and calm axis. Persistent 待核对 right rail, three generously spaced compact rows; use gray surface tint only on this rail. Under chart, a low flat 本月表现 band with three metrics and bridge, no extra nested card. The monthly results and task rail bottom both visible in frame. This is the same application and same data as the other concepts; change information hierarchy, not brand or navigation.

directions.name: 紧凑工作台
directions.text: Direction 紧凑工作台 (internal name only; never display as UI text). Distinct higher-density overview with no large chart. Title and precise three-column summary strip. Below, a left wide 本月表现 area with metric row + result bridge, and right narrower 待核对 compact flat list. Bottom half is a quiet full-width table titled 可投资资产 with small scope 已确认 · 不含在途 and understated 查看持仓 link. Columns 资产 / 类型 / 市值(¥) / 估值日. All labels 14px. 5 meaningful rows of fictional assets: 人民币现金 | 现金 | 500,000.00 | 11.26; 沪深300ETF | ETF | 400,000.00 | 11.26; 全球股票指数基金 | 基金 | 450,000.00 | 11.25; 中短债基金 | 基金 | 350,000.00 | 11.25 (amber 待更新 next to date); 黄金积存 | 黄金 | 152,000.00 | 11.26. Footer 已确认合计 ¥1,852,000.00 · 在途 ¥8,000.00. These five rows sum exactly to1,852,000 and with pending8,000 equal investable1,860,000. Use ruled table rows (52px height) and right-aligned amounts with muted thin column header. This is a flat calm management workspace in the template's visual language, not a broker terminal, not a table inside several rounded cards. No made-up trading buttons.
